sampling.method: family-stratified deterministic round-robin over git-tracked files routed to xml by detectLanguageFromPath; identical method to ontology-census.mts

grammarFacts.Name: PATTERN [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_:.\u00b7-]*
grammarFacts.PEDecl: SEQ['<!ENTITY', S, '%', S, Name, S, (EntityValue|ExternalID), ...] — the `% name` VALUE FORM is a PEDecl, not a PEReference
grammarFacts.consequence: a Name cannot contain whitespace, so interior whitespace inside a PEReference is unreachable for any node the grammar built; only error recovery could produce it

wasmIdentity.note: byte-identical to the registry entry `tree-sitter-xml/tree-sitter-xml.wasm` that src/ast/engine.ts resolveWasm writes to its per-process temp path, so this probe measured the PRODUCTION grammar and not a vendored copy that differs from it

corpus.note: a 0-node corpus compares nothing: both predicates agree because neither is asked. See `shapes` and `fixtures`.
